messages.subject: Project Onyx - legal due diligence request list
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our legal DD request list for Project Onyx is attached (file to follow directly). Priority items: cap table and option grants, IP ownership and any infringement correspondence, material customer contracts (we understand there's a Stratton Energy agreement with a change-of-control clause) and the HMRC R&D enquiry. Could the company populate the data room by 19 December?

Adam Selby | Partner | Denham Lewis LLP
